caller_obligations: Bind actual descriptor, row identity, checkpoint, policy and selected bundle; a revision string alone is not provenance proof.
This scalar per-tensor format is distinct from the older per-output-row quantization assets; do not mix weight signs or delta tables.
The helper accepts generic exponent bucket lists and positive positions; a hardware driver must enforce the adapter four-slot table and representable context/address bounds.
Returned keep is NOT predicted skip even when prune=False; unpruned hardware must use all-keep. This trained diagnostic explicitly used prune=True.
Diagnostic packed feature payload is plane-concatenated; the actual hardware archive remains three interleaved feature bytes per strip.

method.arithmetic: Existing ties-away saturated gate/up, sampled/interpolated SiLU, single signed8 down-input plane and complete down projection.
method.input: Actual signed8 codes, signed9 activation exponent, pre-gamma outlier mask and pre-gamma outlier-negative bits; no activation re-quantization or old rounded-mask reconstruction.
method.output_unit: eDown + down_shift - 8 - up_gain_bits, one scalar exponent per output row.
method.phase: Ordinary prefill only; protected-first and decode phases are explicitly rejected.
method.prediction: Signed outlier-to-weight sign margins; skip iff outlier_count>0 AND gate_margin<=0 AND up_margin==0. Thresholds are local choices; the paper does not disclose their exact numeric values.
method.weight_format: Complete per-tensor signed8 gate/up/down weight matrices with scalar exponents; stored zero weight codes have positive sign.

notation.Q8: Fixed-point encoding with eight fractional bits.
